  1530→// - JSONL format (one JSON object per line, used by Claude Code)
  1531→func (env *TestEnv) validateTranscriptJSONL(checkpointID string, expectedContent []string) {
  1532→	env.T.Helper()
  1533→
  1534→	transcriptPath := SessionFilePath(checkpointID, paths.TranscriptFileName)
  1535→	content, found := env.ReadFileFromBranch(paths.MetadataBranchName, transcriptPath)
  1536→	if !found {
  1537→		env.T.Fatalf("Transcript not found at %s", transcriptPath)
  1538→	}
  1539→
  1540→	// First try to parse as a single JSON document (OpenCode/Gemini format)
  1541→	var jsonDoc any
  1542→	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(content), &jsonDoc); err == nil {
  1543→		// Valid JSON document - validation passed
  1544→	} else {
  1545→		// Fall back to JSONL validation (Claude Code format)
  1546→		lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
  1547→		validLines := 0
  1548→		for i, line := range lines {
  1549→			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
  1550→			if line == "" {
  1551→				continue
  1552→			}
  1553→			validLines++
  1554→			var obj map[string]any
  1555→			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &obj); err != nil {
  1556→				env.T.Errorf("Transcript line %d is not valid JSON: %v\nLine: %s", i+1, err, line)
  1557→			}
  1558→		}
  1559→
  1560→		if validLines == 0 {
  1561→			env.T.Error("Transcript is empty (no valid JSON content)")
  1562→		}
  1563→	}
  1564→
  1565→	// Validate expected content appears in transcript
  1566→	for _, expected := range expectedContent {
  1567→		if !strings.Contains(content, expected) {
  1568→			env.T.Errorf("Transcript should contain %q", expected)
  1569→		}
  1570→	}
  1571→}

   335→// getMetadataTree returns the metadata branch tree and a fresh repo handle.
   336→// After a fetch, go-git's storer cache may be stale (new packfiles on disk
   337→// are invisible to the repo opened before the fetch). To avoid this, each
   338→// attempt opens a fresh repo after the fetch succeeds.
   339→//
   340→// Fallback order: treeless fetch → local → full fetch → remote tree.
   341→func getMetadataTree(ctx context.Context) (*object.Tree, *git.Repository, error) {
   342→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "resume.getMetadataTree")
   343→
   344→	// Helper to log ref hash for a repo's metadata branch
   345→	logRefHash := func(repo *git.Repository, source string) {
   346→		ref, refErr := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName("entire/checkpoints/v1"), true)
   347→		if refErr != nil {
   348→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "metadata branch ref not found",
   349→				slog.String("source", source),
   350→				slog.String("error", refErr.Error()),
   351→			)
   352→			return
   353→		}
   354→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "metadata branch ref resolved",
   355→			slog.String("source", source),
   356→			slog.String("ref_hash", ref.Hash().String()),
   357→		)
   358→	}
   359→
   360→	// Always try treeless fetch first to ensure local branch is up-to-date
   361→	if fetchErr := FetchMetadataTreeOnly(ctx); fetchErr == nil {
   362→		// Open a fresh repo so the storer sees new packfiles from the fetch
   363→		freshRepo, repoErr := openRepository(ctx)
   364→		if repoErr == nil {
   365→			logRefHash(freshRepo, "treeless-fetch")
   366→			metadataTree, treeErr := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(freshRepo)
   367→			if treeErr == nil {
   368→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "metadata tree obtained via treeless fetch",
   369→					slog.String("tree_hash", metadataTree.Hash.String()),
   370→				)
   371→				return metadataTree, freshRepo, nil
   372→			}
   373→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "treeless fetch succeeded but tree read failed",
   374→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()),
   375→			)
   376→		}
   377→	} else {
   378→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "treeless fetch failed, trying local",
   379→			slog.String("error", fetchErr.Error()),
   380→		)
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	// Try local (may have been set by a prior fetch or push)
   384→	localRepo, repoErr := openRepository(ctx)
   385→	if repoErr == nil {
   386→		logRefHash(localRepo, "local")
   387→		metadataTree, err := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(localRepo)
   388→		if err == nil {
   389→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "metadata tree obtained from local branch",
   390→				slog.String("tree_hash", metadataTree.Hash.String()),
   391→			)
   392→			return metadataTree, localRepo, nil
   393→		}
   394→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "local metadata branch not available",
   395→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   396→		)
   397→	}
   398→
   399→	// Fallback: full fetch from remote
   400→	if fetchErr := FetchMetadataBranch(ctx); fetchErr == nil {
   401→		freshRepo, repoErr := openRepository(ctx)
   402→		if repoErr == nil {
   403→			logRefHash(freshRepo, "full-fetch")
   404→			metadataTree, treeErr := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(freshRepo)
   405→			if treeErr == nil {
   406→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "metadata tree obtained via full fetch",
   407→					slog.String("tree_hash", metadataTree.Hash.String()),
   408→				)
   409→				return metadataTree, freshRepo, nil
   410→			}
   411→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "full fetch succeeded but tree read failed",
   412→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()),
   413→			)
   414→		}
   415→	} else {
   416→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "full fetch failed",
   417→			slog.String("error", fetchErr.Error()),
   418→		)
   419→	}
   420→
   421→	// Try remote tree directly (origin/entire/checkpoints/v1)
   422→	remoteRepo, repoErr := openRepository(ctx)
   423→	if repoErr != nil {
   424→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", repoErr)
   425→	}
   426→	logRefHash(remoteRepo, "remote-tracking")
   427→	remoteTree, remoteErr := strategy.GetRemoteMetadataBranchTree(remoteRepo)
   428→	if remoteErr != nil {
   429→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "remote metadata tree also not available",
   430→			slog.String("error", remoteErr.Error()),
   431→		)
   432→		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("metadata branch not available: %w", remoteErr)
   433→	}
   434→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "metadata tree obtained from remote-tracking branch")
   435→	return remoteTree, remoteRepo, nil
   436→}

   447→// findBranchCheckpoints finds the most recent commit with an Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   448→// among commits that are unique to this branch (not reachable from the default branch).
   449→// This handles the case where main has been merged into the feature branch.
   450→func findBranchCheckpoints(repo *git.Repository, branchName string) (*branchCheckpointsResult, error) {
   451→	result := &branchCheckpointsResult{}
   452→
   453→	// Get HEAD commit
   454→	head, err := repo.Head()
   455→	if err != nil {
   456→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   457→	}
   458→
   459→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   460→	if err != nil {
   461→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   462→	}
   463→
   464→	// First, check if HEAD itself has a checkpoint (most common case)
   465→	if cpIDs := trailers.ParseAllCheckpoints(headCommit.Message); len(cpIDs) > 0 {
   466→		result.checkpointIDs = cpIDs
   467→		result.commitHash = head.Hash().String()
   468→		result.commitMessage = headCommit.Message
   469→		result.newerCommitsExist = false
   470→		return result, nil
   471→	}
   472→
   473→	// HEAD doesn't have a checkpoint - find branch-only commits
   474→	// Get the default branch name
   475→	defaultBranch := getDefaultBranchFromRemote(repo)
   476→	if defaultBranch == "" {
   477→		// Fallback: try common names
   478→		for _, name := range []string{"main", "master"} {
   479→			if _, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(name), true); err == nil {
   480→				defaultBranch = name
   481→				break
   482→			}
   483→		}
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	// If we can't find a default branch, or we're on it, just walk all commits
   487→	if defaultBranch == "" || defaultBranch == branchName {
   488→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil
   489→	}
   490→
   491→	// Get the default branch reference
   492→	defaultRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(defaultBranch), true)
   493→	if err != nil {
   494→		// Default branch doesn't exist locally, fall back to walking all commits
   495→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   496→	}
   497→
   498→	defaultCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(defaultRef.Hash())
   499→	if err != nil {
   500→		// Can't get default commit, fall back to walking all commits
   501→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   502→	}
   503→
   504→	// Find merge base
   505→	mergeBase, err := headCommit.MergeBase(defaultCommit)
   506→	if err != nil || len(mergeBase) == 0 {
   507→		// No common ancestor, fall back to walking all commits
   508→		return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, nil), nil //nolint:nilerr // Intentional fallback
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Walk from HEAD to merge base, looking for checkpoint
   512→	return findCheckpointInHistory(headCommit, &mergeBase[0].Hash), nil
   513→}

   515→// findCheckpointInHistory walks commit history from start looking for a checkpoint trailer.
   516→// If stopAt is provided, stops when reaching that commit (exclusive).
   517→// Returns the first checkpoint found and info about commits between HEAD and the checkpoint.
   518→// It distinguishes between merge commits (bringing in other branches) and regular commits
   519→// (actual branch work) to avoid false warnings after merging main.
   520→func findCheckpointInHistory(start *object.Commit, stopAt *plumbing.Hash) *branchCheckpointsResult {
   521→	result := &branchCheckpointsResult{}
   522→	branchWorkCommits := 0 // Regular commits without checkpoints (actual work)
   523→	const maxCommits = 100 // Limit search depth
   524→	totalChecked := 0
   525→
   526→	current := start
   527→	for current != nil && totalChecked < maxCommits {
   528→		// Stop if we've reached the boundary
   529→		if stopAt != nil && current.Hash == *stopAt {
   530→			break
   531→		}
   532→
   533→		// Check for checkpoint trailer
   534→		if cpIDs := trailers.ParseAllCheckpoints(current.Message); len(cpIDs) > 0 {
   535→			result.checkpointIDs = cpIDs
   536→			result.commitHash = current.Hash.String()
   537→			result.commitMessage = current.Message
   538→			// Only warn about branch work commits, not merge commits
   539→			result.newerCommitsExist = branchWorkCommits > 0
   540→			result.newerCommitCount = branchWorkCommits
   541→			return result
   542→		}
   543→
   544→		// Only count regular commits (not merge commits) as "branch work"
   545→		if current.NumParents() <= 1 {
   546→			branchWorkCommits++
   547→		}
   548→
   549→		totalChecked++
   550→
   551→		// Move to parent (first parent for merge commits - follows the main line)
   552→		if current.NumParents() == 0 {
   553→			break
   554→		}
   555→		parent, err := current.Parent(0)
   556→		if err != nil {
   557→			// Can't get parent, treat as end of history
   558→			break
   559→		}
   560→		current = parent
   561→	}
   562→
   563→	// No checkpoint found
   564→	return result
   565→}

   491→func findCheckpointInHistory(start *object.Commit, stopAt *plumbing.Hash) *branchCheckpointsResult {

   494→	const maxCommits = 100 // Limit search depth
   495→	totalChecked := 0
   496→

   499→		// Stop if we've reached the boundary
   500→		if stopAt != nil && current.Hash == *stopAt {
   501→			break
   502→		}

   506→			result.checkpointIDs = cpIDs

   508→			result.commitMessage = current.Message

   511→			result.newerCommitCount = branchWorkCommits
   512→			return result
   513→		}

   515→		// Only count regular commits (not merge commits) as "branch work"
   516→		if current.NumParents() <= 1 {
   517→			branchWorkCommits++
   518→		}
   519→
   520→		totalChecked++
   521→
   522→		// Move to parent (first parent for merge commits - follows the main line)
   523→		if current.NumParents() == 0 {

   525→		}

   530→		}

   532→	}
